group-2022-i-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，主题是如何寻找并与健身搭档（workout partner）有效合作。文章先点明拥有健身搭档的好处，再依次讲解寻找搭档的步骤：明确需求、发布寻找启事、与搭档磨合。五个空分别考查段内/段间的衔接与照应。

discourseStructure.summary: 全文按"好处—如何寻找—如何相处"的顺序展开：开头借杂志文章引出健身搭档的益处，随后用一个设问"how do you find a workout partner"统领下文，分步说明明确需求、就近寻找、撰写启事，最后说明如何与有不同技能的搭档合作共赢。

units.heading: Five Reasons to Thank Your Workout Partner
units.summary: 引用杂志文章列举有健身搭档的理由，第36空补全其中一条理由。

units.heading: So, how do you find a workout partner?
units.summary: 以设问统领，分步讲解寻找搭档：先明确自己的需求（37），再说明搭档应就近（38），并以作者搭档发布启事为例引出启事应包含的信息（39）。
说明搭档之间技能不同，应接受差异、彼此配合，从而共同受益（40）。

topicClues: Five Reasons to Thank Your Workout Partner

contextEvidence.headingAnchor: Five Reasons to Thank Your Workout Partner
contextEvidence.afterQuote: With a workout partner, you will increase your training effort as there is a subtle (微妙) competition.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 work harder 与空后 increase your training effort 属同一"更努力训练"话题场，互为概括与展开。
空后 increase your training effort 正是选项 work harder 的具体说明，呼应有搭档则更卖力训练。

mechanismSignals.signalText: if you train with someone else
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中条件状语 if you train with someone else 与空后 With a workout partner 指向同一情境，构成"与人同练则更努力"的条件—结果关系。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本空补全杂志列举的又一条理由，C项"和别人一起训练会更卖力"正好被空后"有搭档就会增加训练投入、存在微妙竞争"所印证。

matchedClues.contextSide: increase your training effort / subtle (微妙) competition
matchedClues.optionSide: work harder if you train with someone else
matchedClues.relation: 有竞争故更卖力，与选项"和他人同练会更努力"完全对应。

q-2022-i-036.teachingNote: 理由列举类空格要看后文的解释句，找与之同义概括的选项。

topicClues: decide what you want from that person
Or do you just want to be physically fit
the exercises you would like to do
able to move with strength and flexibility

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: First of all, decide what you want from that person.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Or do you just want to be physically fit, able to move with strength and flexibility?

mechanismSignals.targetText: Do you want to be a better athlete in your favorite sport?
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后以 Or 引出另一选择性疑问句，要求空内本身也是一个并列的选择性疑问句，D项正是"想成为更好的运动员吗"。

mechanismSignals.signalText: better athlete in your favorite sport
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项"在喜爱运动中成为更好的运动员"与空后"只想强身健体"构成两个并列的目标选项。

mechanismSignals.signalText: decide what you want from that person
mechanismSignals.targetText: Do you want to be a better athlete
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前"先决定你想从对方那里得到什么"领起空内的设问，二者属"明确健身目标"话题场。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前提出"先决定你想要什么"，空后用 Or 列出另一可能，故本空应是与之并列的一个设问，D项"你想成为运动健将吗"与"只想强身健体"恰成两选项。

matchedClues.contextSide: Or do you just want to be physically fit
matchedClues.optionSide: Do you want to be a better athlete in your favorite sport?
matchedClues.relation: Or 连接的两个 do you want 疑问句构成"竞技 vs 健身"两类目标。

q-2022-i-037.teachingNote: 看到空后 Or + 疑问句，空内多半是与其并列的同结构设问。

topicClues: posting what you are looking for on social media
won’t result in a useful response

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: but it probably won’t result in a useful response.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: If you plan on working out in a gym, that person must belong to the same gym.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项"通常需住得近"与空后"必须属于同一家健身房"同属"地理就近"话题场，后者是前者的具体例证。
空后"同一健身房"印证了空内"住得近"这一就近原则。

mechanismSignals.targetText: A workout partner usually needs to live close by.
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前指出网上发帖难有 useful response，暗示真正有用的搭档需就近，与选项"需住得近"衔接。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用"若在健身房锻炼，对方必须属于同一家健身房"举例说明就近的重要性，正好印证B项"健身搭档通常需住得近"。

matchedClues.contextSide: that person must belong to the same gym
matchedClues.optionSide: A workout partner usually needs to live close by.
matchedClues.relation: 同一健身房是"住得近"的具体表现，构成总—分关系。

q-2022-i-038.teachingNote: 段中空若后接以 If 举的具体例子，空内常是该例子所例证的概括性原则。

topicClues: Her notice included what kind of training
listed her favorite sports and activities

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: It also listed her favorite sports and activities, and provided her phone number.

mechanismSignals.targetText: what kind of training / how many days a week / favorite sports and activities / phone number
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中 such information 回指空前列举的训练内容、天数、爱好、电话等信息，构成总结性照应。
选项 notice 与空前 Her notice 词汇复现，话题一致。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Any notice ... should include such information
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前以作者搭档的 notice 为例罗列各项内容，空内由此归纳出"任何启事都应包含此类信息"。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段先以作者搭档的启事为例列举其包含的种种信息，段末空用G项"任何寻找训练搭档的启事都应包含这类信息"进行总结，其中 such information 正回指前文所列各项。

matchedClues.contextSide: what kind of training / how many hours / favorite sports / phone number
matchedClues.relation: such information 概括并回指前文逐项罗列的启事内容。

q-2022-i-039.teachingNote: 段末空遇到 such / these 等回指词，先找前文被概括的具体内容来定位答案。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: You and your partner will probably have different skills.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Over time, both of you will benefit

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 your differences 回指空前 different skills，名词照应使语段衔接。
选项 work with each other 与段末 help each other 属同一"彼此配合"话题场，呼应共同受益。
空前"你和搭档可能技能不同"为空内"接受差异、学会配合"提供前提。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前说"你和搭档可能技能不同"，空后讲"久而久之双方都会受益"，F项"接受彼此差异并学会与对方配合"承上启下，your differences 正回指 different skills。

matchedClues.contextSide: different skills / both of you will benefit
matchedClues.optionSide: accept your differences and learn to work with each other
matchedClues.relation: 接受差异、相互配合是"双方共同受益"的前提，衔接自然。

q-2022-i-040.teachingNote: 看到选项中的 differences、this 等回指词，先在空前找它所指代的名词以确认衔接。
